editorial:
Imagine living in 1974 Italy, where the legal system feels like it is rigged against women. You meet a determined lawyer who is tired of seeing rapists walk free because of a judge who clearly hates women. Instead of just filing more paperwork, she decides to take matters into her own hands. The movie feels like a tense game of cat and mouse, where the vibe is heavy with anger and a need for real payback. You will feel the frustration of the main character as she builds a secret plan to make the judge pay for his crimes.

The acting is great and really makes you root for the lawyer, even when she does things that are technically illegal. Some parts of the movie move a bit slow, but the big payoff at the end makes it all worth it. If you love stories about revenge and fighting the system, you need to see this. To get the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the lawyer successfully traps the judge in a situation where he is forced to face the same fear and powerlessness his victims felt. She uses her knowledge of the law to twist the knife and ensure he loses everything. The twist is that she doesn't just want him in jail; she wants him broken. It wraps up with her finally finding peace knowing the bad guy got exactly what he deserved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves legal thrillers and revenge stories.
